text: The Patriots head to Jacksonville for a Week 3 AFC showdown against a Jaguars team expecting a favorable response after their worst offensive performance in eleven months, though New England's defense will need to solve Cover-6 looks and build on their "X" plays to keep the momentum from their 20-3 win over Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers—all while managing significant roster disruptions, as starting right guard Mike Onwenu suffered a broken right ankle that will ripple through the offense, rookie tight end Eli Raridon has returned to practice after monitoring his status, and the team made moves by promoting linebacker Jose Ramirez from the practice squad and placing safety Dell Pettus on injured reserve. Beyond the injury headaches, the coaching staff has also acknowledged they need to tighten up their clock management late in the second quarter after two straight games with questionable decisions before halftime, a self-awareness that could prove critical in a road game against a Jacksonville team hungry for offensive redemption.
